hypothesis: A symmetric visual classifier over a parent and an explicit daughter pair can rank true divisions more precisely than independent edge softmax while leaving the robust one-to-one parent untouched.
parent: Reciprocal 24-movie scratch registered-Hungarian result, pooled score 0.6761456762872732.

candidate_representation.model_inputs: Shared normalized 11^3 crops for the parent and two daughters plus immediate physical geometry: ordered parent-daughter distances, daughter separation, midpoint displacement and radial-distance gap.
candidate_representation.symmetry: Daughter embeddings enter only through sum and absolute difference; swapping daughters is unit-tested invariant.
candidate_representation.post_classifier_gate: Future continuation and sister divergence are not model inputs. They remain the already frozen graph-safety gate applied after pair classification on competition movies.

training: Eight deterministic epochs on exactly 256 external train shards; all division parents plus a deterministic 5% sample of ordinary parents; nearest four daughter candidates; BCE positive weight 12; AdamW 2e-4. Validation scores all parents in exactly 64 time-disjoint shards.
external_gate: Select one epoch and one parent-level threshold on the 64 external validation shards. Proceed only if daughter-pair AP is reported, proposal recall ceiling is at least 0.90, division-parent precision is at least 0.50 and recall is at least 0.20.
competition_gate: If and only if the external gate passes, freeze checkpoint/threshold and score the two source-validation movies in each reciprocal direction. Both directions must be nonnegative; a direction with no true division must add zero false forks. Target OOF remains unopened until then.
prospective_target_gate: One 24-movie reciprocal pass only after source gates. Require nonnegative score in both embryo directions, positive pooled score, at least one of 13 true divisions recovered, added-division precision at least 0.25 and acceptable leave-one-movie-out stability.
reproducibility: AveragePool3d replaces nondeterministic MaxPool3d; launcher sets CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 before Python starts; deterministic algorithms and fixed seed 158031 remain enabled.
resource: One RTX6000 through the common queue; 8 CPU, 32 GiB RAM, 6 GiB disk, 60 minutes; one GPU job for this project.
